# GitHub Copilot instructions for EnergoCheck

- Work in Russian for user-visible messages and documentation.
- Use English names for Python classes, functions, files, and modules.
- Keep architecture modular and aligned with Django + clean architecture principles.
- Apply business roles strictly: CONSUMER and EMPLOYEE only.
- Prefer Django templates, Bootstrap, and htmx over SPA frameworks.
- Use Decimal for monetary and energy values.
- Keep business logic in services/selectors rather than views.
- Validate with Django checks, migrations, and relevant tests before finishing each block.
